name: Garakuta no Utopia
original_name: がらくたのユートピア
source:
A young man wakes up in a post-apocalyptic world and falls in love with a piece of junk.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/29783]Freem![/url]]
translation:
一个年轻人在一个后世界末日的世界中醒来，爱上了一件垃圾。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/29783]Freem![/url]]
